parts.html: The K-12 standard model is a contemporary L-shaped kitchen in warm beige tones with a wood texture. Simple geometry and wood-effect decor make the interior cozy.
Neutral tones make the furniture look lighter and pair well with light walls, natural stone, and decorative plaster.
The main feature of the K-12 is its two types of fronts: foil-wrapped uppers and lowers made of laminated chipboard. A shared wood decor ties them into one composition.
Work surfaces, built-in appliances, and cabinets run along two adjacent walls, and with no island there is room left for a dining area.
The doors close smoothly on Hettich soft-close hinges, and the drawers glide out on concealed Muller runners.
Hinge type: Hettich with soft-close mechanism
We will tailor the K-12 to your kitchen’s dimensions, utility connections, and built-in appliances — with design, manufacturing, and installation in Bratislava and Vienna.
